name: Futaba☆Channel 3.5
source:
Mysteriously, a bar of soap transformed Itsuki into a girl. 
Summer vacation is now over, and he's off to a three-day study lodge sleepover. 
Strange experiences await the boy-turned-girl and his female companions. 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE086892.html]DLsite English[/url]]
